payload.title: Mechanisms of mitochondrial injury by approved drugs: a review
payload.abstract: Mitochondrial dysfunction is a recurring mechanism in idiosyncratic liver injury. This review collates the evidence linking approved drug classes to impaired oxidative phosphorylation, beta-oxidation and mitochondrial DNA replication. We tabulate published potency values from hepatic and non-hepatic models and note that assay format strongly influences the apparent rank order. Particular attention is given to the galactose substitution assay and to seahorse respirometry. The review closes with a discussion of why in vitro mitochondrial signals translate poorly to clinical risk at the level of the individual patient. No primary data are reported.
